problem_statement: The CoAP client cannot send a GET request to a multicast address and stream responses from multiple servers as described in RFC 7252 section 8. A request should be able to specify a multicast collection timeout and have its response callback invoked once per responding server (each callback carrying that server's unicast source address and length), followed by one final callback with a NULL source that signals no more responses will arrive for that request. A multicast request that is marked confirmable must be rejected as an error (multicast requests are always non-confirmable), a request that sets a multicast timeout for a unicast destination must be rejected, confirmable (CON) responses to a multicast request must be dropped instead of being acknowledged, and blockwise (Block1/Block2) responses in multicast mode must be dropped. Observe and multicast together must also be rejected.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/lib/coap_client -s tests/net/lib/coap_client/net.coap.client -s net.coap.client -O twister-out --no-clean -W
